description: Declares, per absence-claim category, which resource-type queries must appear in the recorded query coverage before absence may be treated as established (decisions 16 and 20). The deterministic verifier proves 'queries Q were executed and returned no matching resource', never 'the condition does not exist'.
notes: An absence claim whose category cannot be determined is 'not_evaluable', which drives abstention rather than a violation.
Coverage is satisfied only when every required resource type appears in the recorded queries_executed set.
